summary: Verified Live Editor new hex color inputs and full Header Style panel. Admin login succeeded; dock + toggle render; selecting a section exposes live-sec-bg + live-sec-bg-hex (hex input applies section bg live). Selecting a text node exposes live-font-color + live-font-color-hex (hex applied red color live). Site text panel contains Header Style block with all 9 required testids (bg/bg-hex, color/color-hex, font select with 16 fonts, pad-top, pad-bottom, save, reset). Setting header bg=#efe6d8 and font=Public Sans then clicking Save produced <style data-testid=header-style-overrides> with '.site .header { background: #efe6d8 !important; }' and font-family override; header visually turned cream. Reset+Save removed the overrides and header returned to white (confirmed in final screenshot). 'Header style saved' toast appeared confirming PUT /api/admin/site-styles succeeded.
critical_code_review_comments: Header computed bg after save showed rgb(255,255,255) in the automation evaluate — but screenshot clearly shows cream header; likely the selector '.site .header' hit a different element than the computed-style query (header element is actually the outer banner). Not a functional bug — override tag content and visual rendering are correct.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All new ColorField hex inputs (live-sec-bg-hex, live-font-color-hex, live-header-bg-hex, live-header-color-hex) and the Header Style block in SiteChromeEditor (testid live-header-style) are implemented and work. Live preview updates immediately; header persistence via PUT /api/admin/site-styles works and emits a header-style-overrides <style> tag. Reset+Save was performed to leave the preview at default. Section bg (#f0e9dd) and text color (#aa0000) edits were in-memory draft only (no explicit Save was clicked) so no backend persistence should remain, but a hard reload should be done if a cleaner baseline is needed.
